text.content: Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) is the central authority for identity, authentication, and security policies in a Windows environment. In Windows Server 2025, establishing a Domain Controller remains a strict two-phase process: first, installing the AD DS server role, and second, promoting the server to act as a Domain Controller.
